Our philosophy

Why Clínica Belba is not a commercial clinic

At Clínica Belba we do not work with standard surgeries or rushed decisions.

Every patient is assessed individually and we only recommend a procedure when it is truly the right option.

  1. The same surgeon assesses you, operates on you and follows you up

  2. Recovery is part of the treatment

  3. We operate in leading hospital settings in Barcelona

Our commitment is medical, not commercial.

Specialities

Plastic surgery procedures in Barcelona

At Clínica Belba we perform plastic and reconstructive surgery in Barcelona, always after a personalised medical assessment. Our aim is not to transform but to improve naturally, respecting each patient's anatomy and realistic expectations.

About us

Plastic surgery clinic in Barcelona within a leading hospital environment

Location, medical safety and real support

Our clinic is located in Barcelona at Via Augusta 281, 4th floor A, and works with premium hospitals of the Teknon Group, guaranteeing the highest standards of medical safety. We see patients from Barcelona and all over Spain looking for a plastic surgery clinic in Barcelona with medical judgement, experience and real follow-up.

Book online

Professionals

Our team of surgeons

The doctor will be your surgeon at every stage. We do not delegate assessments, follow-ups or recovery. The same specialist is with you before, during and after surgery to ensure a natural, safe result that matches your expectations.

Dr. Mike Dewever

Plastic, reconstructive and aesthetic surgeon

"The best surgery is the one decided calmly, with medical judgement and realistic expectations."

Specialist in body and facial surgery with a precise approach that respects each patient's anatomy. In breast surgery he uses advanced mammoplasty techniques that prioritise tissue preservation, a natural result and safety throughout, with continuous medical follow-up from the first consultation to the last check-up.

Dra. Marel Gómez

Specialist in facial and body aesthetic procedures

"Every patient is unique. Listening and supporting are part of the result."

Specialised in aesthetic breast surgery with a personalised approach focused on natural results. Her priority is that every breast surgery decision is fully informed, looking after both the aesthetic result and the patient's wellbeing and peace of mind before, during and after the procedure.

Dra. Laura Torrano Romero

Plastic, reconstructive and aesthetic surgeon

Specialist in plastic and reconstructive surgery with specific experience in breast and lymphoedema units at Barcelona hospitals. Trained at the University of Navarra with international placements at Stanford and Mayo Clinic. PhD candidate in microsurgery and author of scientific publications on reconstructive breast surgery. One of the few plastic surgeons in Spain trained in both aesthetic and oncological breast surgery.

Dr. Félix Chavarría

Plastic, reconstructive and aesthetic surgeon

"It is not about doing more surgery, but the right surgery."

With extensive experience in plastic and reconstructive surgery, he stands out for his medical judgement and conservative approach when the case allows. In mammoplasty he works with techniques that reduce surgical impact, shorten recovery time and favour a controlled postoperative course, always within the safe hospital environment of the Teknon Group and Hospital Tres Torres.

@graph.name: Dr. Mike Dewever
@graph.description: Inició sus estudios en la Université Libre de Bruxelles y terminó licenciándose en la Universidad de Barcelona y recibiendo el premio extraordinario de licenciatura por sus brillantes resultados académicos. Fue el número 75 del examen MIR, de entre mas de 13.000 participantes. Este logro le permitió realizar su residencia en el Hospital Universitario de Bellvitge. Allí se especializó en cirugía mamaria, plástica y reconstructiva. Al acabar la residencia fue contratado como médico adjunto del servicio de cirugía plástica del mismo Hospital Universitario de Bellvitge. Completó su formación como Cirujano plástico en Barcelona en la Clínica Teknon, y en la Universidad de Columbia, New York. Es autor y co-autor de varias publicaciones nacionales e internacionales. Es miembro de la Secpre y de la SCCP. Sus conocimientos son reconocidos a nivel europeo con el titulo de Fellow of the European Board of Plastic surgery (EBOPRAS 2016). Desde del 2017 se dedica exclusivamente a la cirugía privada, con unos resultados muy exitosos, pues la satisfacción de sus pacientes avala la excelencia de su trabajo. Ha participado en varios curso con el Dr Alfredo Hoyos, leader de la cirugia coroporal a nivel mundial. En cirugia mamaria, es pionero en cirugia mamaria minimamente invasiva, con recuperacion rapida y resutaldos naturales, realizando masterclass sobre su tecnica minimal scar. Ha trabajado durante 4 años en la prestigiosa Clínica Planas, donde ha realizado mas de 600 cirugías, su experiencia acumulada representa mas de 3000 cirugías.
